## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem or friction does this feature solve?
> *e.g., When running Codex CLI in headless mode, I noticed that...*

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working:
- What new hook, template, or tool should be introduced or modified?
- What would the developer experience or prompt look like?

## 🛡️ Architectural Alignment Check
Please verify how this proposal fits within `vibe_multiagent` design principles:
- [ ] **Zero Runtime Dependencies**: Can this be implemented in standard Node.js without adding external npm runtime packages?
- [ ] **Privacy & Local Hygiene**: Does this keep all project files and execution 100% on the local filesystem?
- [ ] **Multi-Agent Protocol**: Does it respect role separation (Lead Orchestrator vs. Delegated Executors)?

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or reference links here.
